[quote=kingdom_of_geranoriskas;60089238]what do I look for and do with the HDI part of the Wiki type, along with time zones, calling code and "drives on the" thing?[/quote]

You can use anything that will let you draw borders for your country on the map. Upload the edited map you made with your borders to imgur or another image hosting website and then you can send that with the form in the dispatch.

For HDI, take an educated guess. Use the timezone map:

https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2672543

Use any number for the calling code and choose if you want your people to drive on the left or right.

You don't need to fill everything, just as much as you want.
